question: _______ is the collection of all bundles of goods that a consumer can purchase with his income at prevailing market prices .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Budget Set**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The budget set is simply a collection of all goods that a consumer can purchase at the prevailing market price using his/her income.
 
• All the bundles which follow the following criteria form a part of the budget set,
 
• 
 
{p1 x1 + p2 x2 ≤ M}
